description: This is a controller source file for the Employee Membership feature within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, responsible for handling employee membership data and rendering related components.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipController
classes.description: Controller class managing employee membership data, rendering Vue components, and handling permissions for employee membership features.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembershipService.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the service container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data and Vue component for rendering the employee membership details based on employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability checking, specifically 'membership'.
